executable_template.patch_strategy: Pass the authoritative reviewed target branch into the structured gate, derive origin/base from the scheduler environment, require exactly one tool/base/target option, and accept diff-helper evidence only when both refs exactly equal the expected values; retain focused negative and caller-plumbing regressions.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Revert target-branch plumbing, exact comparisons, duplicate-option rejection, and their tests together; until a replacement binding exists, disable unattended merge rather than accepting unbound diff-quality evidence.
